case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Two accused (A-1, A-2) were tried and convicted; A-3 became an approver.

accused_gender.reason: Accused referred to with male pronouns, e.g. 'his domestic troubles', and as husband of PW-8.

accused_age.reason: No age is given for any accused in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of the accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased Shankar referred to with male pronoun 'his death'.

victim_age.reason: The deceased's age is not given anywhere in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: Shankar who was totally innocent and an un-intended victim of the crime
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment gives no relationship with Shankar; 'Stranger' is inferred. Accused had enmity with intended target PW-14.

offence_category.reason: Offence of murder under s.302 IPC is stated.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 302, 307, 427 r/w 34 IPC and s.3 Explosive Substances Act r/w 34 match.

weapon.reason: Bomb (explosive in a tape recorder) is the weapon described.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness/injured witness testimony, approver testimony, circumstantial, medical, forensic (FSL) evidence
evidence_type.quote: direct as well as circumstantial evidence produced in the case
evidence_type.reason: Circumstantial, medical, forensic and approver evidence are supported; 'dying declaration' and 'recovery' are not stated.

confession.correct_value: Approver A-3's testimony after pardon relied on; extra-judicial confession by A-1 and A-2 to PW-3 also relied on
confession.quote: A1 and A2 confessed before them that they have kept the bomb in the said box
confession.reason: Approver's testimony and an extrajudicial confession by A-1 and A-2 are relied on; value omits the latter.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Established motive and bomb planted to kill are supported by the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted the appellant of the listed offences.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court upheld conviction and sentence.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so the conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Conviction for murder under s.302 r/w s.34 was upheld.

imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for life for the s.302 offence is stated.

imprisonment_years.quote: rigorous imprisonment for life and a fine of Rs.5,000/-
imprisonment_years.reason: Sentence is life imprisonment; no 20-year term is stated.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs.5,000 for the s.302 offence is stated.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused, with another person, arranged for an explosive device to be planted at a shop to kill its owner. The bomb exploded when opened, killing one employee and injuring two others. The accused were tried for murder and related offences.
neutral_facts.quote: found guilty and sentenced by the Trial Court
neutral_facts.reason: Neutral facts reveal the outcome (convicted, sentenced, courts found evidence sufficient), which is prohibited.

offence_severity.reason: All four sentences and fines match the judgment's sentencing paragraph.

attempt_completion.reason: Bomb exploded causing death and injuries; completed offence is reasonable.

physical_harm.reason: Death of Shankar and injuries to Krishna (PW-1) and Shivaram (PW-7) are stated.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Four offences charged; all four convictions upheld on appeal
number_of_offences.quote: In the result this appeal fails and is hereby dismissed
number_of_offences.reason: All four convictions were upheld; 'three finally upheld' contradicts the dismissal of the appeal.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Damage to the shop and articles lying around from the blast (s.427 mischief charge)
financial_property_loss.quote: exploded with a huge sound damaging the shop and several articles lying around
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment describes damage to shop and articles; s.427 charge reflects property loss.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Planning evident from procuring gelatin and detonators, testing them, and planting the bomb; premeditation not expressly found
premeditation_planning.quote: the spot as the one where they had experimented the gelatin stick and the electric detonator
premeditation_planning.reason: Planning is supported by the evidence, but the court did not expressly find premeditation.

motive.reason: Motive of domestic troubles attributed to PW-14's interference and threats is supported.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness, injured witness, approver and forensic evidence were accepted as supporting the prosecution.

witness_credibility.correct_value: Court found no reason to discard PW-3's evidence; approver's testimony accepted only after corroboration as an approver is a criminal
witness_credibility.quote: we find no good reason to discard the evidence of PW-3
witness_credibility.reason: The 'no reason to discard' finding concerns PW-3, not the approver; approver evidence required corroboration.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: After leaving the box, A-1 and A-2 allegedly confessed to PW-3 and threatened him not to disclose it
post_offence_conduct.quote: threatened them not to disclose this fact before anybody
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment states post-offence confession and threats to witnesses, not 'Not stated'.

custody_duration.reason: Judgment states the appellant has undergone 12 years' imprisonment.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 2 April 1996; High Court judgment: 16.03.2004; Supreme Court decision: 8 January 2013; trial court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: Judgment & Order dated 16.03.2004 of the High Court of Karnataka
trial_duration.reason: 16.03.2004 is the High Court judgment date, not the trial judgment; High Court date wrongly marked not stated.

legal_representation.reason: Appellant's and respondent's counsel names match the judgment.

investigation_status.reason: Chargesheet filed after investigation and trial proceeded to conviction.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: convicted and sentenced; High Court: conviction and sentence upheld; Supreme Court: appeal dismissed
appeal_history.quote: which conviction and sentence has been upheld by the High Court
appeal_history.reason: 'Trial court: Conviction upheld' is wrong; the trial court convicted and the High Court upheld.

prosecution_argument.reason: Summary of the prosecution case, motive, threats and corroboration matches the judgment.

defence_argument.reason: Defence contended approver evidence was uncorroborated and unsafe; motive challenge is implied by the High Court's reasoning.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Accomplice testimony admissible but requires corroboration in material particulars, per s.133 and rule of practice.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: Evidence Act s.133 and the established rule of practice on approver corroboration; no case law cited
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Section 133 of the Evidence Act, makes an accomplice a competent witness
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Statutory provision and rule of practice are supported; the judgment cites no precedents.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Judgment gives no sentencing rationale; 'grievous hurt' is not mentioned anywhere.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Judgment does not discuss mitigating factors; 'None' asserts an absence not stated.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Judgment does not discuss aggravating factors; 'None' is not supported by the text.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Co-accused A-1 released prematurely on 15 August 2006 under order dated 14 August 2006; his appeal (Crl.A. 134/2005) dismissed as infructuous
other_sentence_order.quote: has since been released prematurely on 15th August, 2006 in terms of order dated 14th August, 2006
other_sentence_order.reason: Judgment states co-accused A-1's premature release and dismissal of his appeal, contrary to 'None'.
